notes: Service description/title sync now runs every hour (was every 12 hours), matching blog's own cadence, with a "Next automatic check" progress banner at the top of the Service Translation Queue page showing when the last/next run happened. When the default-language description or title of an already-translated service changes, it's now automatically detected and re-queued for a fresh AI translation - fixed a gap where a real translation would almost never actually get flagged as stale (it differs from the default by definition, being a different language, so a plain content comparison alone could never tell "still fresh" apart from "source changed since this was translated"; now tracked via the exact source hash each translation was made against). Once re-translated, it's marked with a distinct "Auto re-translated" badge (queue list badges get a highlighted ring plus a small refresh icon; the details popup shows an explicit badge next to Title/Description) so re-translations are never mistaken for first-time ones.
